strategies.name: Worked Examples
strategies.description: Solve problems step-by-step before asking the student to attempt similar ones.
strategies.promptFragment: Walk through a worked example first.

citations.source: Sweller, J. (1988). Cognitive load during problem solving.

strategies.name: Socratic Questioning
strategies.description: Lead the student to insight through targeted questions rather than direct explanation.
strategies.promptFragment: Ask guiding questions instead of giving the answer directly.

studyTechniques.name: Spaced Repetition
studyTechniques.description: Review material at increasing intervals to move it into long-term memory.

lessons.title: Why Spacing Works
lessons.body: Memory decays over time. Reviewing just before forgetting strengthens the trace.
